title: Supplementary mobile code governance needs reviewed authorization and monitoring evidence
remediation: The deployment application security owner defines mobile code technologies and approved uses within the assessed boundary. Verify authorization, monitoring and enforcement through a sampled approval and benign permitted and denied tests in an authorized environment. Retain reviewed configuration and oversight records without recording live code or content.

milestones.title: Collect the approved technology and use register, redacted effective controls and a sampled authorization and monitoring result
